description: This file defines the FileCacheFactory class in the Drupal framework, responsible for creating and managing FileCache objects with configurable settings and cache prefixes.

classes.name: FileCacheFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating FileCache objects with configurable options.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Creates and returns a FileCache object based on collection and configuration.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the current configuration used for creating FileCache objects.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration to be used for creating future FileCache objects.
